# MDD Platform — Ops Dashboard
Metadata-driven CSV pipeline (bronze → data quality → silver, with quarantine & schema-drift rescue), orchestrated hourly by the job **MDD Pipeline Orchestration Job**. Every widget queries governed views in `mdd_platform.ops` only.
**Color key:** 🟢 ok · 🟡 warning · 🔴 critical

## Pipeline Runs & Reliability
Auto Loader checkpoints (bronze) and silver watermarks make every hourly run incremental and idempotent — a no-op run touches nothing.

frame.title: Run detail (recent first) — filterable via Global Filters page

lines:
## Data Quality & Quarantine
YAML rules evaluated per microbatch: failing rows land in `mdd_platform.quarantine.<source>` with `_failed_rules`. **Aging SLA: 24h** — `within_sla` 🟢 / `SLA_breached` 🔴.

frame.title: Failed rows by rule (per source) — failing rules first
Rule evaluation status by source (passing 🟢 / failing 🔴)
Quarantine aging by source — within_sla 🟢 / SLA_breached 🔴
Quarantined records — filterable by source via Global Filters page

lines:
## Schema Drift & Rescue
Auto Loader `PERMISSIVE` mode rescues data that doesn't match the declared YAML schema (e.g. the `extra_column` drift from batch_002 header drift) into `_rescued_data` — nothing is lost.

frame.title: Rescued values by Auto Loader microbatch

lines:
## PII Governance & Access
PII columns declared in YAML → Unity Catalog governed tags + mask functions applied at silver. Access events come from the UC audit trail.

### ⚠ Governance gap to remediate
The orchestration job has **no notification targets configured** (`not_configured`). Add email / webhook notifications to *MDD Pipeline Orchestration Job* so failures alert on-call instead of surfacing only on this dashboard.

frame.title: PII coverage by column (20 fully governed 🟢)
Recent PII-relevant access (who touched mdd_platform — silver flagged)

lines:
## Performance, SLA & Cost
Freshness: 🟢 fresh / 🟡 stale / 🔴 critical. Perf flags: ok 🟢 / slow 🟡 / compute_wait 🟠 / error 🔴. Cost from billing telemetry (~1 day lag).

frame.title: Spark query performance (ok 🟢 / slow 🟡 / compute_wait 🟠 / error 🔴)
Job DBU consumption by day (billing telemetry lags ~1 day — empty until data lands)

lines:
## File Lifecycle Costing
End-to-end cost of each source file across **landing → bronze → DQ → silver**. Wall-clock stage spans are upper bounds; run-scoped compute time comes from run-log durations. Cost = job DBUs from `billing.usage` once telemetry lands (~1 day lag), else **estimated** (1 DBU per active compute-hour × $0.35 serverless list price) — `cost_source` marks the basis.
**Color key:** bronze 🟤 · dq 🟠 · silver 🔵 — totals are tiny by design: only 20 small demo files have run so far.

### Cost basis — `estimated` (all rows today)
Billing telemetry lags ~1 day. Once it lands, the views flip `cost_source` to `billing_usage` (DBUs of job **433265226360788**, pro-rated by raw rows per file).
**Duration model** (see view comments):
* `arrival_to_bronze_seconds`, `dq_seconds`, `silver_merge_seconds` — **wall-clock spans** (upper bounds)
* `bronze_run_seconds`, `silver_run_seconds` — **run-scoped compute time**
* `active_compute_seconds` — sum of run-scoped compute across stages
**Storage:** exact once `system.storage.table_metrics_history` daily snapshots include the tables; interim estimate = row_count × raw bytes/row (1.37× observed ratio).
⚠ These views re-scan the landing volume via `read_files`, so the first load of each widget can take **1–2 min**. Views regenerate over `config.pipeline_configs` — re-run the *MDD Ops Costing Views* notebook after adding sources.
